segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ יֵשׁ מְבִיאוֹת קׇרְבָּן וְנֶאֱכָל, וְיֵשׁ מְבִיאוֹת קׇרְבָּן וְאֵינוֹ נֶאֱכָל, וְיֵשׁ שֶׁאֵינָם מְבִיאוֹת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «There are» some women who «bring» a sin «offering» of a woman after childbirth «and» the offering «is eaten» by the priests. «And there are» some women who «bring» a sin «offering but it is not eaten. And» there are «some» women who «do not bring» a sin offering at all.

segments.he: מְבִיאוֹת קׇרְבָּן וְנֶאֱכָל: הַמַּפֶּלֶת כְּמִין בְּהֵמָה חַיָּה וָעוֹף, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי מֵאִיר. וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: עַד שֶׁיְּהֵא בּוֹ מִצּוּרַת אָדָם.
segments.en: The mishna elaborates: The following women «bring» a sin «offering and it is eaten» by the priests: «One who miscarries» a fetus with a form «similar to a domesticated animal,» one who miscarries a fetus with a form similar to «an undomesticated animal, or» one who miscarries a fetus with a form similar to «a bird;» this is «the statement of Rabbi Meir. And the Rabbis say:» She does not bring a sin offering «unless» the fetus «has the form of a person.»

segments.he: הַמַּפֶּלֶת סַנְדָּל אוֹ שִׁילְיָא אוֹ שַׁפִּיר מְרוּקָּם, וְהַיּוֹצֵא מְחוּתָּךְ, וְכֵן שִׁפְחָה שֶׁהִפִּילָה, מְבִיאָה קׇרְבָּן וְנֶאֱכָל.
segments.en: With regard to a woman «who miscarries a sandal» fetus, i.e., one that has the form of a flat fish; «or» if she miscarries the «placenta; or an amniotic sac» in which «tissue developed; or» a fetus «that emerged cut,» i.e., in pieces; «and likewise» a Canaanite «maidservant,» owned by a Jew, «who miscarried;» in all these cases «she brings» a sin «offering and it is eaten» by the priests.

segments.he: וְאֵלּוּ מְבִיאוֹת וְאֵינָן נֶאֱכָלוֹת: הַמַּפֶּלֶת וְאֵין יוֹדֵעַ מָה הִפִּילָה, וּשְׁתֵּי נָשִׁים שֶׁהִפִּילוּ, אַחַת מִמִּין פְּטוּר וְאַחַת מִמִּין חוֹבָה. אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי: אֵימָתַי? בִּזְמַן שֶׁהָלְכוּ זֶה לַמִּזְרָח וְזֶה לַמַּעֲרָב. אֲבָל אִם הָיוּ שְׁתֵּיהֶן עוֹמְדוֹת – שְׁתֵּיהֶן מְבִיאוֹת קׇרְבָּן, וְנֶאֱכָל.
segments.en: «And these» women «bring» sin offerings «but» their sin offerings «are not eaten: One who miscarries and does not know» the nature of «what she miscarried; and two women who miscarried,» in a case where «one» miscarried a fetus «of a type» for which a woman is «exempt» from bringing an offering «and» the other «one» miscarried a fetus «of a type» for which a woman is «liable» to bring an offering, and they do not know which miscarried which type. «Rabbi Yosei said: When» is their sin offering not eaten? It is «when» both women «went» to different places within the Temple to bring their offerings, e.g., «this» woman went «to the east and that» woman went «to the west. But if both of them were standing» together, «both of them» together «bring» one sin «offering, and it is eaten.»

segments.he: אֵלּוּ שֶׁאֵין מְבִיאוֹת: הַמַּפֶּלֶת שַׁפִּיר מָלֵא מַיִם, מָלֵא דָּם, מָלֵא גְּנִינִים, הַמַּפֶּלֶת כְּמִין דָּגִים וַחֲגָבִים וּשְׁקָצִים וּרְמָשִׂים, הַמַּפֶּלֶת יוֹם אַרְבָּעִים, וְיוֹצֵא דּוֹפֶן. רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן מְחַיֵּיב בְּיוֹצֵא דּוֹפֶן.
segments.en: «These» women «do not bring» a sin offering: A woman «who miscarries an amniotic sac full of water,» or one «full of blood,» or one «full of» different «colors;» and likewise a woman «who miscarries» a fetus with a form «similar to fish, or grasshoppers, or repugnant creatures, or creeping animals;» and a woman «who miscarries» on the «fortieth day» of her pregnancy; «and» a woman who gives birth by «caesarean section. Rabbi Shimon deems» a woman «liable» to bring a sin offering «in» the case where she gives birth by «caesarean section.»
